real.definition: It actually does something. A measurable or well-proven effect on your games — worth doing.

placebo.definition: All hype, no effect. Popular online, but it changes nothing you can measure. We skip these so you don't waste time chasing them.

risky.definition: Not worth the downside. It might do something, but it brings real tradeoffs — instability, a security hole, or things breaking — so Compy refuses it, or lets you decide with eyes open.

autopsy.urlHowYoutube: Open the video's transcript (⋯ menu → Show transcript) → copy → paste here.
autopsy.urlHowWebpage: Open the page → Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C → paste here. I'll grade every claim.
